title: Births Foretold of John the Baptist and Jesus

questions.question: To whom did Luke address his Gospel, stating he wrote an orderly account so that this person may have certainty concerning the things he had been taught?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:3-4 (ESV): "it seemed good to me also, having followed all things closely for some time past, to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus, that you may have certainty..."

questions.question: Who was the priest of the division of Abijah whose wife was from the daughters of Aaron?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:5 (ESV): "In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah. And he had a wife from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth."

questions.question: What was Zechariah doing in the temple when the angel of the Lord appeared to him?
options: Reading from the scroll of Isaiah
questions.explanation: Luke 1:9-11 (ESV): "according to the custom of the priesthood, he was chosen by lot to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense... And there appeared to him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense."

questions.question: What did the angel Gabriel tell Zechariah to name his son?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:13 (ESV): "But the angel said to him, 'Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.'"

questions.question: Because Zechariah doubted the angel's words, what happened to him until the day these things took place?
options: He was silent and unable to speak
He was confined to the temple
questions.correctAnswer: He was silent and unable to speak
questions.explanation: Luke 1:20 (ESV): "And behold, you will be silent and unable to speak until the day that these things take place, because you did not believe my words..."

questions.question: In the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph. What was the virgin's name?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:26-27 (ESV): "...to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. And the virgin's name was Mary."

questions.question: What name did Gabriel tell Mary to give her son, who will be great and called the Son of the Most High?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:31 (ESV): "And behold, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus."

questions.question: What did the angel say regarding Mary's relative, Elizabeth?
options: "Even Elizabeth your relative has also conceived a son in her old age. And this is the sixth month with her who was called barren."
"She has already given birth to the prophet Elijah."
"She has moved to Nazareth to assist you."
"She has passed away, but her spirit watches over you."
questions.correctAnswer: "Even Elizabeth your relative has also conceived a son in her old age. And this is the sixth month with her who was called barren."
questions.explanation: Luke 1:36 (ESV): "And behold, your relative Elizabeth in her old age has also conceived a son, and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren."

questions.question: What was Mary's final response to the angel Gabriel?
options: "Behold, I am the servant of the Lord; let it be to me according to your word."
"How can this be, since I am a virgin?"
"I must go and tell Joseph immediately."
"Praise the Lord, for he is visiting his people."
questions.correctAnswer: "Behold, I am the servant of the Lord; let it be to me according to your word."
questions.explanation: Luke 1:38 (ESV): "And Mary said, 'Behold, I am the servant of the Lord; let it be to me according to your word.' And the angel departed from her."

questions.question: When Mary visited Elizabeth and greeted her, what happened to the baby in Elizabeth's womb?
options: The baby leaped in her womb
The baby was still and silent
questions.correctAnswer: The baby leaped in her womb
questions.explanation: Luke 1:41 (ESV): "And when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the baby leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: What is the traditional name of the song Mary sings, beginning with "My soul magnifies the Lord"?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:46 (ESV): "And Mary said, 'My soul magnifies the Lord,'" (Often called the Magnificat from the Latin translation).

questions.question: On what day did they come to circumcise Elizabeth's child, where they intended to name him Zechariah after his father?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:59 (ESV): "And on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child. And they would have called him Zechariah after his father,"

questions.question: How did Zechariah indicate what the child's name should be?
options: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, "His name is John."
He gestured with his hands until they guessed it
He took a piece of coal and wrote it on the floor
He nodded vigorously when Elizabeth said John
questions.correctAnswer: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, "His name is John."
questions.explanation: Luke 1:63 (ESV): "And he asked for a writing tablet and wrote, 'His name is John.' And they all wondered."

questions.question: Immediately after Zechariah wrote "His name is John," what happened to him?
options: His mouth was opened and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, blessing God
He fell asleep for three days
questions.correctAnswer: His mouth was opened and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, blessing God
questions.explanation: Luke 1:64 (ESV): "And immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, blessing God."

questions.question: In Zechariah's prophecy (the Benedictus), he said his child (John) would be called what?
options: The prophet of the Most High
The son of the living God
questions.correctAnswer: The prophet of the Most High
questions.explanation: Luke 1:76 (ESV): "And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the Lord to prepare his ways,"

key_verse_text: "For nothing will be impossible with God."
